_comment: Where each broker publishes its SEBI Annexure-B investor-complaint table.
SEBI requires every registered broker to publish monthly received / resolved /
pending complaint counts on its own website. The URL is curated here because
every broker puts it in a different place. THE NUMBERS ARE NEVER CURATED: they
are parsed from the broker's own page, and a page that cannot be parsed with
confidence produces no record at all.
VERIFICATION STATUS: these URLs are starting points and MUST be checked one by
one against each broker's live site before the data is published. Run
`python3 -m pipeline.run complaints` and read the gap log: a wrong URL shows up
as an unparsed broker, never as a wrong number. `verified` records the date a
human last confirmed the URL actually serves the Annexure-B table.
Add a broker by adding its id (must exist in brokers_master.json) and the URL
of the page carrying the table. If a broker publishes only a PDF, leave it out
for now and note it in `format`: PDF parsing is not implemented.

zerodha.note: Zerodha publishes real monthly Annexure-B data (Dec 2021 onward) as a public Google Sheet, linked from https://zerodha.com/disclosure/ under Complaint resolution. The old investor-attention/ URL was the wrong page entirely (investor education content, no complaint table).

hdfc-securities.note: The old /investor-charter URL has no complaints table at all (charter boilerplate only). HDFC publishes a dedicated page per month whose own URL encodes the month, so a static URL would go stale every month - complaints.py's _resolve_monthly_url() tries the current month, then steps back, each run. Also required two parser fixes (parse_annexure_b's total-row label search and page-month detection) since this page's Grand Total row has a blank SN column and its month-bearing heading sits past the page-text scan window.

kotak-securities.note: The old kotaksecurities.com/investor-charter/ URL 404s; Kotak Securities' own sitemap now points entirely to the rebranded kotakneo.com domain (same legal entity). This page's "Trend of monthly disposal of complaints" table carries real, non-template monthly data and parses cleanly with the existing parse_annexure_b (verified against 6 real months, Apr-Sep 2026).
